Bettina, your own cutover recap (public, 8 Dec 2025) gives the date: **3 November 2025** is the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics. You kept running PHL day to day until 21 November, and Kwame took it over fully on 22 November.

For the tracker, I'd use 3 Nov 2025 as the change date and note the 22 Nov full takeover. Source: `members/bettina-kroll/notes/2025-12-08-bettina-pellucid-cutover-recap.md`. Moss's coastal cheat sheet and coverage check don't give a handoff date.
